settings.name: The Land
settings.title: Where the rose wakes
settings.text: Highland fields, mist still in the valleys, the first light on the petals.

settings.name: The Hand
settings.title: Picked before the sun
settings.text: By hand, at dawn, while the scent is still held inside the petal.

settings.name: The Craft
settings.title: Drop by drop
settings.text: Copper, steam and time — until a single drop of oil remains.

settings.name: The Time
settings.title: Oud does not hurry
settings.text: Resin that takes years to form, smoke that takes its time to rise.
